summary: DOUBLE ROOM AVAILABLE Located in the Eastbourne area of Darlington, close to the Amazon building and Cummins, within walking distance to the town centre and a stones throw away from the train station. Ideal for the single professional! Property compromises - communal entrance way leading to each room, double room, shared modern fitted kitchen with oven and hob/living area, shared bathroom, allocated parking, virgin superfast broadband, regular cleaner for communal areas. All bills included, fully double glazed, gas central heating.
